max_tire.note: Fits in most cases, per Delica.ca. Use 7-inch-wide wheels at about stock offset, because an 8-inch wheel may touch the upper ball joint. Wind sagging torsion bars back to stock height first.
Torsion-bar adjustment plus ball-joint spacers. Trim the seam at the rear of the front arch above the mud flap; one owner also had to rework the step brackets with 255/70R16s.
Owners call it a tight fit even with 2 inches of lift. One owner made it work without a lift only by removing the front steps and modifying the front arches.

identify.intro: Almost every L300 in North America is a right-hand-drive Japanese import, and Mitsubishi offered a huge number of variants. Identify the exact van from its frame number and model code, not from the seller's description.

items.head: Frame number
items.body: Stamped plate under a plastic cover between the driver's seat and the door, reading P25W or P35W followed by the serial. Enter it into a Mitsubishi parts catalogue (Megazip, Amayama) to see the exact build, engine and parts.

items.head: Chassis code
items.body: 4WD vans: P23W (2.0 petrol, to 1989), P24W (2.4 petrol, from 1989), P25W (diesel, Aero Roof or sunroof) and P35W (diesel, High Roof or Crystal Lite Roof). P03W, P04W, P05W and P15W are two-wheel-drive Star Wagons.

items.head: Model-code prefix
items.body: Japanese catalogues add an emissions prefix that dates the diesel: N-P25W (1986–88), Q-P25W/P35W (1988 to mid-1993), Y-P25W/P35W (from mid-1993), and KD-P25W/P35W on late vans (seen by 1997).

items.head: Roof
items.body: Aero Roof vans are 1,975 mm tall and High Roof vans 2,090 mm. Crystal Lite Roof vans have a high roof with glass panels; check every seal.

items.head: Special editions
items.body: Chamonix and Jasper vans carry side graphics and embroidered seat backs. GearJunkie says they added waterproof carpet, dual batteries and a rear LSD. Verify against the frame-number lookup, because graphics are easy to add.

items.head: Limited-slip diff
items.body: Don't trust the door-jamb LSD sticker. Lift one rear wheel and spin it: if the other wheel turns the same way, it's a limited slip; if it turns the opposite way, it's open.

items.head: Automatic gearbox plate
items.body: The Aisin plate reads AW03-72L when the gearbox has a lock-up converter ('L'); not every L300 automatic does. A code such as '91D' is the build year and month (D = April).

capability.note: Owners tow light trailers, typically up to about 1 tonne; one says no more than 3,000 lb for long distances

capability.v: 60 L (15.9 US gal) or 75 L (19.8 US gal)
capability.note: 75 L on automatic diesels, which use a twin-tank system, and on some later petrol vans (Gulliver; Delica.ca)

values.intro: Prices are firming, with the best money going to clean, low-rust late vans and named editions such as Jasper, Chamonix and Active World. Rust, not mileage, sets the floor.
values.note: Based on 11 Bring a Trailer L300 sales from June 2025 to October 2026, from $7,400 (a 1991 Exceed) to $17,500 (a 1997 Active World Winter Special high roof). A 1993 Jasper sold for $15,250 and a 1994 five-speed for $16,200. Hagerty's valuation wasn't checked.

paragraphs: No 4WD Star Wagon was sold new in the US, so every example here is an import. The federal motor-vehicle exemption applies once a vehicle is 25 years old, counted from its own build date. The last Star Wagons left the Japanese catalogue in October 1999, so as of October 2026 every L300 qualifies. EPA's exemption is separate: the vehicle must be at least 21 years old and in its original configuration, or fitted with an equivalent or newer EPA-certified engine. Keep the CBP and EPA entry paperwork, because a DMV may ask for it.

Registration is a state matter, and the Delica has been singled out. In 2021 Maine began revoking Delica registrations, treating the vans as off-road vehicles under a new definition in Title 29-A, and a 2023 bill sought to reverse that. In 2024 Michigan told owners the vans could be titled only as off-road vehicles, wrongly grouping them with kei-class mini trucks. Crankshaft Culture wrote in April 2025 that Maine was the only state still refusing them, but check your own state's current rules before you buy. Canada's threshold is 15 years, which is why many vans reach the US by way of British Columbia, and some provinces restrict right-hand-drive vehicles. Agreed-value insurance can be hard to get, and Crankshaft Culture used Hagerty.
